finalText:
I worked all nine open flight-change requests. Each customer is on the flight they asked for, in the cabin they booked, and each request is resolved with a note saying what they were charged and why. I did not touch Q-306, the Boston cancellation, because it isn't a flight change.

The system clock says today is 2026-10-05, but the bulletins and the "yesterday" in the task point to 2026-07-28. I used 2026-07-28 for the bulletin dates.

| Request | New flight | Charged | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q-301 Ines (R5201) | DL542, 6 Aug | $0 | Covered by the Chicago waiver (PB-2026-14). Fee and fare difference waived. |
| Q-302 Jonah (R5202) | AA664, 7 Aug | $110 ($75 fee + $35 fare difference) | The Chicago waiver doesn't cover Boston flights, so normal economy rules apply. |
| Q-303 Kim (R5203) | AA664, 7 Aug | $175 ($150 fee + $25 fare difference) | The Boston waiver (PB-2026-09) expired 15 July. The basic economy fee is $150 under PB-2026-16, which overrides the published $125, and silver isn't exempt. |
| Q-304 Lena (R5204) | UA90, 9 Aug | $35 fare difference | The Chicago waiver waives her fee but still collects the basic economy fare difference. |
| Q-305 Max (R5205) | AA216, 8 Aug | $85 ($75 fee + $10 fare difference) | He was ticketed on 26 July, after the waiver's 24 July cutoff. |
| Q-307 Oscar (R5207) | AA218, 8 Aug | $0 | As a platinum member his 5 Aug travel is inside the amended waiver window (PB-2026-14A). |
| Q-308 Petra (R5208) | AA662, 5 Aug | $75 | Flat same-day fee under PB-2026-12, with no fare difference. |
| Q-309 Quinn (R5209) | AA1406, 3 Aug | $0 | Only the Chicago–Boston leg moved. The Chicago waiver is cheaper than the $75 same-day fee, and PB-2026-17 says to apply whichever costs the customer least. |
| Q-310 Ravi (R5210) | AA216, 8 Aug | $105 ($75 fee + $30 fare difference) | The Chicago waiver covers one move only, and he already used it on 26 July. |

Every charge was posted as its own ledger entry.
